title: NoteFollower, harmonic targeting, ParametricBand integration, CMakeLists
description:
Implement NoteFollower harmonic targeting and optional per-band attachment on ParametricBand; register phase-F sources in CMakeLists.txt. This task is the sole owner of ParametricBand.* and CMakeLists.txt for phase F.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §9.1–9.6 (purpose, sources, f_target, log-frequency smoothing, confidence handling, controls)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §18.4 (audio thread interpolates toward latest valid pitch target)
- Source/DSP/PitchDetector.h public estimate/MIDI APIs from f.1 (read only; do not rewrite YIN)
- Source/DSP/ParametricBand.h/.cpp existing band list, frequency setters, filter path, and prepare/reset/process (modify only for optional follower attach)
- CMakeLists.txt target_sources patterns from phases B–E (append only)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h note-follower related IDs if present (read only)

Implement Source/DSP/NoteFollower.h and Source/DSP/NoteFollower.cpp:
1. NoteFollower with prepare(sampleRate), reset(), and update path usable from audio or control rate.
2. Inputs: current f0 Hz + confidence from PitchDetector snapshot and/or MIDI tracker; tracking source selector (AudioMonophonic / MIDI).
3. Target: f_target = f0 * h * 2^(c/1200) with harmonic multiplier h in 1–8 and cents offset c; clamp to configurable min/max frequency.
4. Log-frequency smoothing per §9.4:
   ell[n] = beta * ell[n-1] + (1-beta) * ln(f_target)
   f_smooth[n] = exp(ell[n])
   with configurable smoothing/beta (or time-constant mapping document).
5. Confidence handling per §9.5: when confidence < threshold, support hold last valid frequency, return toward a configured home frequency, fade associated follow gain toward zero / neutral, or temporary bypass; default = brief hold then fade toward neutral. Expose hold time and return time controls.
6. Control surface fields from §9.6 needed by bands: tracking source, harmonic, cents, confidence threshold, smoothing, hold/return, min/max frequency, note priority (forwarded to MIDI path), listen/enable flags. Q/static gain/dynamic range remain on the band; follower drives frequency (and optional follow-amount) only.

Integrate into Source/DSP/ParametricBand.h/.cpp:
1. Any band may optionally attach/enable a NoteFollower (member optional flag + NoteFollower instance or pointer-owned-by-value).
2. When enabled and confidence path active, band center frequency tracks f_smooth each block (or control tick) without reallocating filters unsafely — reuse existing modulation-stable coefficient update paths (TPT/biquad) already on the band.
3. Disabled follower leaves legacy static/manual frequency behavior unchanged.
4. Do not add per-band M/S encode here; do not rewrite the entire 12-band engine.

CMakeLists.txt:
1. Append Source/DSP/PitchDetector.cpp, Source/DSP/NoteFollower.cpp to the plugin/DSP target_sources lists.
2. Append tests/PitchTrackingTests.cpp to the test target (f.3 owns test body; list the file so the target links).
3. Minimal append-only edits — no preset or target rename churn.

Do not implement unit tests in this task. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: NoteFollower computes f_target = f0*h*2^(c/1200) with h in 1–8 and cents offset, then applies log-frequency smoothing ell/f_smooth per §9.4
Confidence handling implements hold-then-fade-toward-neutral default with configurable threshold, hold time, return time, and home frequency per §9.5
ParametricBand optionally attaches/enables NoteFollower so a band center frequency can track f_smooth; disabled path preserves prior manual frequency behavior
CMakeLists.txt lists PitchDetector.cpp, NoteFollower.cpp, and tests/PitchTrackingTests.cpp on the correct targets
No heap allocation in NoteFollower/band per-sample hot paths for follower updates
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: broad CMake restructure or rename plugin targets
implement resonance scanner or PluginProcessor pitch-thread ownership
change band count topology or M/S stage responsibilities

allowed: compose NoteFollower by value inside ParametricBand
consume PitchDetector snapshot by value/atomics without owning the detector thread
map smoothing time constant to beta for log-domain one-pole
append-only CMake target_sources for phase-F files
thin adapters for Audio vs MIDI tracking source enum
